thread:
jess: Quick heads-up 1 saw a jump in per-model unit cost on the cost dashboard that lines up with yesterday's routing tweak. Prefetch path rows are showing much higher cost than live path for the same model. :grimacing:
amar: which model and time window? any query you used?
jess: m-mini-pro, window 2026-04-07T10:00:00Z -> 2026-04-07T11:00:00Z. simple check: `SELECT route, model, SUM(tokens)*unit_price AS raw_cost, SUM(cache_credit) AS credits FROM token_events WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-04-07T10:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-07T11:00:00Z' GROUP BY route,model` shows credits=0 on many prefetch rows.
toni: router change was to favor prefetch for latency-tier==low in canary. Could be a tagging gap. infra-bot: rollout-canary-pegasus started by @releasebot at 2026-04-07T09:50:00Z targeting tenant cohort size 12%.
amar: are the router logs emitting the cache credit header? check for `x-cache-credit` or legacy `x-rw-cache-credit`.
jess: grep shows mixed results. some invocations have `x-rw-cache-credit=120`, others no header at all. sample lines: `2026-04-07T10:12:02Z tenant=88 inv=inv_123 route=prefetch x-rw-cache-credit=120` and `2026-04-07T10:12:03Z tenant=88 inv=inv_124 route=prefetch`.
toni: if header missing our econ-ingest would not apply credits, so dashboard shows full cost. UX-wise that's scary for product teams.
amar: short fix: make econ-ingest accept both headers and add a small mapping layer. medium fix: add a reconciliation job that estimates credits for invocations with route=prefetch and missing credit header for last 72h.
sylvie: UX suggestion: on the cost dashboard show a `credits_pending` flag and display an estimated `post_credit_unit_cost` when credits are pending. also annotate rows that fall inside active rollouts.
jess: +1. also add an alert threshold: if post-credit delta > 40% sustained for 15m, send econ-channel alert (not page SRE yet).
amar: backend sketch: `INSERT INTO econ_backfill (invocation_id, estimated_credit, note) SELECT i.id, LEAST(i.estimated_kv_savings, i.token_cost*0.8), 'prefetch-missing' FROM invocations i WHERE i.route='prefetch' AND i.ts > now() - interval '72 hours' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM econ_backfill b WHERE b.invocation_id = i.id);` We should mark these as estimated for reconciliation later.
toni: pausing the canary to reduce noise while we patch router tagging. releasebot: action queued: pause-rollout pegasus (reason: econ-credit-investigation).
sylvie: small UX PR: add `post_credit_unit_cost` column with tooltip showing calculation and link to backfill run id. color rows with estimated credits in yellow and add banner "Crediting under investigation: results may be provisional".
amar: i'll open ENG-7330 (header-mapping + backfill) and ENG-7331 (dashboard UX), ENG-7332 (e2e test).
jess: will add dashboard annotation for the 10-11 window and ping CS if billing exposure > 1% for any tenant. thanks team. :thanks:
